decodedFragment.description: If the user used obfuscation (e.g., 'd!sc0rd'), output the normalized text here.

items.description: The exact header of the violated rule from the policy text (e.g., '1. PERSONAL IDENTIFIABLE INFORMATION').

policyCitations.description: List of rules violated. Must be empty if isSafe is true.

reasoning.description: A brief explanation of why the content was flagged, citing specific keywords or intent.

riskLevel.description: The severity of the violation based on the policy context.

isSafe.description: Set to false if any rule from the provided policy text is violated.
